name: Thunderstorm
description:
Deals wind damage with a potency of 600 to all enemies in a cone before you.
Potency increases to 780 when used against targets weak to wind.
Potency scales with item level.
Cast and recast timer cannot be affected by status effects or gear attributes.
Shares a recast timer with Hellfire and Judgment Bolt.
